pipeline.html.lead: This page explains the pipeline template and how to use it.

topics.title: A pipeline
text: A pipeline is a service that runs commands each time someone changes the code.

topics.title: Not tested live
text: The template has not run in a live pipeline yet.

history.html.lead: This page says how to keep the history of a repository, and how to read it for mistakes.

topics.title: Pull request
text: A pull request is a proposal to merge a change into the main branch. It holds the discussion and the approval.

topics.title: Signed commit
text: A signed commit carries a signature of its author. The code host shows whether the signature belongs to the account.
